## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### Змагання на підтримку України 🇺🇦. 
##### 50% внесків будуть передані фандрейзинговій платформі [United24](https://u24.gov.ua/).
##### Всі відвідувачі змагань мають обов’язково ознайомитись з розділом ["Запобіжні заходи"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/U24TetianaDay2023#24524-safety-measures).
Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/kubikinua).

### Competition in support of Ukraine 🇺🇦. 
##### 50% fees will be donated to the fundraising platform [United24](https://u24.gov.ua/).
##### All visitors MUST read the section ["Safety measures"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/U24TetianaDay2023#24524-safety-measures) carefully.
Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/kubikinua).

### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM.
